title: EL4CTEO/fast-anything
why_read: A practical, sensible workflow tool for using AI coding agents to selectively optimize hot code paths rather than full rewrites, addressing a common real engineering pain point.
analysis: This tool encourages a targeted optimization workflow: profile a Python, Node, or Ruby application to find the small portion of code that's actually slow, then use an AI coding agent to port just that hot path to a faster language while verifying behavioral equivalence. This is a pragmatic alternative to the often-impractical advice to 'rewrite everything in Rust,' focusing effort where it has the most performance payoff. The approach of pairing profiling with agent-assisted porting and correctness verification is a sensible, engineering-grounded use of AI coding tools. It's a useful pattern for engineers facing performance bottlenecks without wanting a full language migration.
